2607.03650.title: ClinOCR-Bench: A Comprehensive Clinical Scanned Document Dataset for Optical Character Recognition Model Evaluation
2607.03650.paper_summary: Extracting textual information from scanned medical documents, such as external laboratory reports and manually filled forms, has been a major challenge in modern electronic health records (EHRs). Recent advancements in vision language models (VLMs) have shown great promise over traditional OCR tools. However, at this point, most clinical OCR studies were conducted on private, institutional data. To our knowledge, there are few publicly available datasets for evaluating OCR models in the clinical domain. Furthermore, common scanning artifacts that undermine OCR performance are not reflected in those datasets, leaving a systematic evaluation unfeasible. Therefore, we release a publicly available, realistic-looking OCR benchmark dataset, ClinOCR-Bench, with 384 scanned images across 6 subsets: Normal, Handwriting, Poor Quality, Rotation, Tables, and Mix-artifacts. ClinOCR-Bench features: 1) diverse document types and layouts, 2) full coverage of common EHR scan artifacts, 3) protected health information-free, 4) template-aware train/test split, and 5) adequate sample size for OCR benchmarking. Baseline OCR performance was evaluated using state-of-the-art open-weight and proprietary VLMs. The dataset and documentation are available on GitHub (https://github.com/ClinOCR-Bench/ClinOCR-Bench).
2607.03650.paper_summary_zh: 從掃描的醫療文件中提取文本信息，例如外部實驗室報告和手動填寫的表格，一直是現代電子健康記錄（EHRs）中的一大挑戰。最近在視覺語言模型（VLMs）方面的進展顯示出比傳統OCR工具更大的潛力。然而，目前大多數臨床OCR研究都是在私有的機構數據上進行的。據我們所知，公開可用的數據集用於評估臨床領域的OCR模型非常少。此外，影響OCR性能的常見掃描伪影在這些數據集中並未得到反映，這使得系統評估變得不可行。因此，我們發布了一個公開可用的、看起來現實的OCR基準數據集，ClinOCR-Bench，包含384張掃描圖像，分為6個子集：正常、手寫、低質量、旋轉、表格和混合伪影。ClinOCR-Bench的特點包括：1）多樣的文檔類型和佈局，2）全面涵蓋常見的EHR掃描伪影，3）不包含受保護的健康信息，4）模板意識的訓練/測試劃分，以及5）足夠的樣本大小以進行OCR基準測試。基準OCR性能使用最先進的開放權重和專有的VLM進行評估。數據集和文檔可在GitHub上獲得（https://github.com/ClinOCR-Bench/ClinOCR-Bench）。
